status: Retained source fixture. Rail-aligned solid reconstruction is integrated as a streamed measured-industrial layer; broad port selection is recorded separately.
attribution: Actueel Hoogtebestand Nederland (AHN) / Het Waterschapshuis — AHN6
selectionReason: One coherent flight strip. Other strips observe cranes and container stacks at different times, so merging them creates duplicate poses. This pass has the widest source footprint of the observed passes. Its missing northern coverage remains missing.

referenceImage.purpose: Independent source comparison only; not visible map textures

comparedCandidates.method: Exposed 2 m occupied voxels, all strips
comparedCandidates.conclusion: Rejected: fragmented lattice and duplicate crane poses

comparedCandidates.method: Locally smoothed occupied surface, all strips
comparedCandidates.conclusion: Rejected: smoothed overlapping poses are still false geometry
Better spatial coherence; still rough, softened and incomplete

comparedCandidates.method: Source RGB assigned to eleven muted per-face colours
comparedCandidates.conclusion: Rejected: surface mottling clashes with solid miniature style

comparedCandidates.method: Single-flight occupied cells aligned to measured crane rails, small-gap closing, one colour per connected form
comparedCandidates.conclusion: Accepted as the solid-form direction for in-map and broader port checks

productionReconstruction.colour: One muted source-derived colour per connected form
productionReconstruction.heightConvention: NAP used numerically as model height to match the existing municipal model; not an ellipsoidal conversion
